summary: Verified blank-preview fix. Supervisor now runs expo from /app/admin-app (confirmed via ps aux showing /app/admin-app/node_modules/.bin/expo). Root and entry.bundle both return HTTP 200. All required admin-app screens render correctly on mobile viewport (390x844): /admin/login (Admin Login title, tagline, prefilled admin email, password input, green 'Login to Admin Panel' button, 'Authorized administrators only.' footer, 'Delivery Boy Login' pill), /admin auth-gates and redirects to /admin/login, /admin/delivery-boys (header 'Delivery Boys', '0 active · 0 total' subtitle, search input, green + Add button, 'Loading delivery boys…' state — layout paints, not blank), /admin/delivery-boys/new (full Add Delivery Boy form with all fields + info tip + green Create button, all testIDs present), /delivery/login (Delivery Boy Login title, email + password fields, Login button). Fix is verified working.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — appears on every screen. Non-blocking but should be migrated to boxShadow for React Native Web compatibility going forward.

Console error: 'ExpoNotifications.getLastNotificationResponse is not available on web'. The push notification init path is invoked on web where it's unsupported. Should be guarded with Platform.OS !== 'web' before calling notification APIs. Non-blocking for the current blank-preview fix verification.

action_items: None blocking. Optional cleanup: guard expo-notifications calls with Platform.OS !== 'web' to silence console errors on the admin web preview.
Optional cleanup: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to remove deprecation warnings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin app served at /app/admin-app via supervisor. Public URL: https://b9a9e20c-61e2-4013-a69c-303d125cc2d3.preview.emergentagent.com. Firebase auth-gated — /admin redirects to /admin/login when unauthenticated. Real admin creds needed to test dashboard beyond login gate. testIDs available on all interactive elements.
rca_of_issue: Root cause (already fixed by main agent): supervisord.conf had directory=/app/frontend for [program:expo], so Metro was bundling the wrong project. Fix: changed to directory=/app/admin-app and restarted. Verified via `ps aux | grep expo` showing /app/admin-app/node_modules/.bin/expo, HTTP 200 on / and /node_modules/expo-router/entry.bundle?platform=web, and all admin-app routes rendering their expected content and testIDs.
